title: Grateful Dead Live at Cafe au Go-Go on 1969-09-30
lineage: AUD > ? > Cass x2 > XLR into SV-3700 > ZA2 > SoundForgeNoise Reduction > CD

ai_review.summary: A muddy 1969 audience tape that still captures a historic first China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider segue and a killer The Other One.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its historical significance – the band’s first recorded China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider transition and an explosive The Other One – and many listeners feel it was well‑played despite being a “sloppy” late‑’69 outing. The AUD source, however, suffers from hiss, muffled vocals, speed inconsistencies and overall muddiness that force the listener to work at the mix. For completists the performance outweighs the technical flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is generally good (historic first China>Rider, strong The Other One) while recording quality is consistently described as poor; weighted average yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muddy and hissy mix, vocals barely audible, speed/pitch problems (e.g., slow Alligator), overall unclean sound; a few reviewers note occasional surprising clarity for a 1969 AUD.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Short, historically interesting set featuring the first known China>Rider segue and a powerful finish with The Other One; overall well‑played despite occasional sloppiness.
